subject.title: [Bug]: Respawned CLI signals exit with status 1

question: Should the protected maintainer issue be assigned for a focused cross-wrapper signal-status repair now?
rationale: The bug is source-confirmed and bounded, but the protected `maintainer` label requires an explicit owner decision before automation or closure.

options.title: Sponsor focused repair
options.body: Update every respawn wrapper to preserve forwarded SIGINT/SIGTERM statuses and add regression coverage for normal signal and hard-failure paths.

options.title: Hold for launcher work
options.body: Keep the issue open as the canonical status-propagation requirement if a broader launcher supervision refactor is already planned.

recommendation.title: Sponsor focused repair
recommendation.body: Update every respawn wrapper to preserve forwarded SIGINT/SIGTERM statuses and add regression coverage for normal signal and hard-failure paths.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent focused work on respawn-child shutdown makes this the closest current history route.
